digest.component_or_area: git-backed tickets store synchronization and compaction
propositions: Parallel multi-session writes cause compaction to mutate the worktree (SNAPSHOT write, renames, deletions) before git commit with no rollback on worker death, leaving dirty trees that abort `git merge origin/tickets` and strand local commits.
Runtime markers `*/.archived` and `*/.write.lock` are tracked in HEAD and never un-tracked by gitignore, causing routine marker churn to perpetually show as dirty tree state.
Store-wide scans (fsck, compact-all) must default to active tickets only and accept `--include-archived` to include archived tickets, so scan cost scales with the active working set.

Compaction fold requires an intent journal sentinel written before first worktree mutation and removed on all completion paths to enable crash-recovery that reverts abandoned partial folds under the write lock.
Sync union merge must recover both untracked-file collisions and tracked-file deletion/modification aborts to prevent stranding local commits and breaking plan-review attestations.
fsck must detect dirty-tree and stale-lock classes (tracked deletions, untracked regenerable artifacts, orphaned locks), and doctor --repair must heal them safely under the write lock.
